top_news.title: FarSky: Task-Aware Latent-Space Coupling for Generative Intra-Hour Solar Forecasting
top_news.dek: FarSky uses latent-space coupling to improve intra-hour solar irradiance forecasting via all-sky imagery.
top_news.brief: The FarSky framework addresses limitations in deterministic solar forecasting by using a multi-task autoencoder to learn task-aware representations. By coupling latent spaces, the model improves the prediction of cloud dynamics and ramp events, which are critical for integrating photovoltaic power into electrical grids.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing the FarSky generative forecasting framework architecture

top_news.title: Previewing Ultrafast mode: GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 14X the speed
top_news.dek: OpenAI introduces Ultrafast, a new API tier for GPT-5.6 Sol that achieves up to 750 tokens per second.
top_news.brief: Powered by Cerebras hardware, the Ultrafast tier runs GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14 times faster than standard processing. The service is designed for latency-sensitive applications and workflows requiring high-throughput model inference.
top_news.image_alt: Graph showing token generation speed comparison between standard and Ultrafast tiers.

top_news.title: Mistral OCR 4.1
top_news.dek: Mistral AI has released OCR 4.1, a specialized model optimized for document parsing and optical character recognition tasks.
top_news.brief: The new model is designed to handle complex document structures, improving accuracy for data extraction and digitization workflows. It is now available via Mistral's inference platform.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram illustrating document parsing workflow using Mistral OCR 4.1.

top_news.title: Vercel Launches v0 API for Headless App Building
top_news.dek: Vercel has made its v0 API generally available, allowing developers to programmatically generate and deploy applications.
top_news.brief: The v0 API enables developers and AI agents to iterate on, preview, and deploy web applications through direct API calls. This headless approach facilitates automated frontend development and integration into existing CI/CD pipelines.
top_news.image_alt: Code snippet showing a v0 API call for application generation.
